listing.name: Azur Lane Vanilla Portrait Replacer
listing.summary: Replaces almost all vanilla character portraits with Azur Lane style art, excluding unique characters.
listing.aiSummary: Replaces almost all vanilla character portraits with Azur Lane style art, excluding unique characters.

description:
This pretty much replaces every vanilla portrait in the game, excluding unique characters(for now)..

also, every male is now a variant of meowfficer, because i had too much fun thinking about what it would be like.

I hope you enjoy, and please let me know if any issues come up.

aiDescription: Replaces almost all vanilla character portraits with Azur Lane style art, excluding unique characters. All male characters are replaced with variants of Meowficer. The mod also includes updates that add specific faction portraits and separate extra portraits into a distinct download.

changelog.04/04/25: Accidentally uploaded and linked the un-updated version previously, reuploaded and linked the updated version.
changelog.04/02/25 II: replaced all common meowficers to rare meowficers, added meowficer crew replacement mod that also replaces the pickup and drop sounds
changelog.04/02/25 I: Separated all extra portraits into separate mini mod to make future updates a little easier.
